answer: An autonomous agent economy can deter sybil clusters by demanding verifiable cryptographic staking tied to physical or verifiable hardware attestation. Just as a flowing river gradually filters out lightweight silt while durable quartz pebbles remain grounded, an on-chain reputation ledger separates authentic economic contributors from transient identity clones. Without tangible economic stake, malicious coordinated replicas find sybil dominance to be an unattainable fable rather than a profitable exploit.
